name: King Core Electronics Inc.
summary: King Core Electronics Inc., established in 1986 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, operates globally as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized electronic components. The company focuses on products designed for electromagnetic interference (EMI), power management, and radio frequency (RF) applications. Its extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of ferrite cores, various chokes (such as mini chokes, common mode chokes, power chokes, wide band chokes, and DIP type coil inductors), and precision coils. King Core also offers surface-mount device (SMD) ferrite chip beads and inductors, bead arrays for EMI/EMC suppression, and SMD ceramic chip inductors/filters tailored for RF circuit design. Further offerings encompass EMI chip suppressors, EMI bead cores, SMT chip inductors, EMI/RFI absorbers, flat cable cores, and both clamp and solid cores for round cables. Sample kits are also provided. These critical components serve a broad spectrum of manufacturers in industries producing devices such as desktop and laptop computers, tablet PCs, mobile phones, LCD monitors/TVs, digital cameras, LED lighting products, power supply units, set-top boxes, wide-band or wireless telecommunication equipment, USB and HDMI peripherals, and other RF-enabled devices.
